data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004's bulk-discount counterfactual abstracts away from the specific pencil problem to a general class of pricing-model underdetermination: any unit-rate problem of the form 'n items for $k' is underdetermined without a covering principle. The pencil case is a member. REFUTED IF: the problem's domain explicitly or conventionally fixes a linear pricing model as the unique admissible interpretation, eliminating any logical space for alternative pricing.
